description: Figure 8, titled "Distribution of LM’s answer refusal categories on FACTBENCH," presents a series of four pie charts that illustrate the breakdown of reasons for model refusal across four different large language models: GPT4-0, Gemini1.5-Pro, Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct. Each pie chart is segmented to show the proportion of refusals falling into specific categories, with the categories and their corresponding counts and percentages labeled directly on the chart. For GPT4-0, the largest segment is "Lack of Knowledge" at 83.3% (5 instances), followed by "Safety" at 16.7% (1 instance). In the Gemini1.5-Pro chart, "Misinformation" is the most frequent reason, accounting for 38.4% (33 instances), followed by "Lack of Knowledge" at 22.1% (19 instances), "Clarification" at 14.0% (12 instances), and "Ethical Advice" at 16.3% (14 instances). The Llama3.1-70B-Instruct chart shows "Lack of Knowledge" as the dominant category at 75.0% (3 instances), with "Clarification" at 25.0% (1 instance). For Llama3.1-405B-Instruct, "Misinformation" is the most common refusal reason at 50.0% (2 instances), and "Lack of Knowledge" is the second most common at 50.0% (2 instances). The visual data indicates that the distribution of refusal reasons varies significantly between the models, with "Lack of Knowledge" being a major factor for GPT4-0 and Llama3.1-70B-Instruct, while "Misinformation" is the primary reason for Gemini1.5-Pro and Llama3.1-405B-Instruct.
